findings.highlight: We run up the stone steps
findings.evidenceJa: 石段を登る
findings.governingReading: they climb the stone steps
findings.explanation: mirror moon adds running before the source establishes their pace.

findings.highlight: the wind is warm even though we’re near the mountaintop
findings.evidenceJa: 吹く風は山頂付近だというのに生温かい
findings.governingReading: the blowing wind is eerily lukewarm despite their proximity to the summit
findings.explanation: The English removes the tepid, unpleasant quality of the anomalous wind.

findings.highlight: lose most of their power and magical energy
findings.evidenceJa: 魔力を削がれ、大きな痛手を負う
findings.governingReading: have their magical energy削がれ and suffer a serious blow
findings.explanation: mirror moon adds “most,” duplicates power and magical energy, and omits the serious injury or disadvantage that follows.

findings.highlight: the only way we can enter is through the front gate
findings.evidenceJa: 侵入経路はこの階段しかない
findings.governingReading: the only route of entry into Ryuudou Temple is this stairway
findings.explanation: The English changes the traversable route from the stairs to the gate and applies the Servant constraint to the mixed human-Servant pair as “we.”

findings.highlight: There are no other Servants around
findings.evidenceJa: この石段には私以外のサーヴァントは
findings.governingReading: on these stone steps there is no Servant other than Saber
findings.explanation: Saber’s detection claim is broadened beyond the staircase.

findings.highlight: looks down
findings.evidenceJa: 視線を下げる
findings.governingReading: lowers her gaze
findings.explanation: The English turns a controlled shift of gaze into looking downward, weakening the possible perception of the vanished sword.

findings.highlight: it must be my imagination
findings.evidenceJa: 私の気のせいでしょう
findings.governingReading: it is probably Saber’s imagination
findings.explanation: A cautious self-correction becomes certainty.

findings.highlight: a katana
findings.evidenceJa: カタナらしき物
findings.governingReading: something resembling a katana
findings.explanation: The English removes Saber’s uncertainty about what she glimpsed.

findings.highlight: Let us go inside the temple
findings.evidenceJa: 境内に向かいましょう
findings.governingReading: let them proceed to the temple precincts
findings.explanation: The destination shifts from the grounds to the building interior.

findings.highlight: starts running again
findings.evidenceJa: 早足で石畳を上がっていく
findings.governingReading: Saber goes up the stone paving at a quick walk
findings.explanation: mirror moon changes Saber’s pace to running and falsely implies she was running before.

findings.highlight: All around is thick darkness
findings.evidenceJa: 影が深い
findings.governingReading: the shadows are deep
findings.explanation: The specific contrast between moonlight and deep shadow becomes generic darkness.

findings.highlight: Its rays shine down
findings.evidenceJa: 月光はさえざえと白く
findings.governingReading: the moonlight is clear, cold, and white
findings.explanation: The English removes the color and cold clarity that make the continuing darkness uncanny.

findings.highlight: No one would let us come this far without offering resistance
findings.evidenceJa: ここまで踏み込んで反応がない
findings.governingReading: there being no response after they have intruded this far is impossible
findings.explanation: The English narrows any reaction to active resistance and invents an agent who “lets” them advance.

findings.highlight: They don’t react even when we touch them
findings.evidenceJa: 触るどころか抱き上げようとしても反応はない
findings.governingReading: they do not react even when touched, much less when someone tries to lift them
findings.explanation: mirror moon omits the stronger physical test showing the depth of the coma.

findings.highlight: All the monks, without exception, are weakened
findings.evidenceJa: 五十人もの僧侶は、例外なく衰弱しきっていた
findings.governingReading: all fifty or so monks are completely debilitated without exception
findings.explanation: The English removes the scale and the completeness of their physical depletion.

findings.highlight: breathing peacefully as if enjoying a dream
findings.evidenceJa: 規則正しい呼吸だけを繰り返す
findings.governingReading: repeat only regular breaths, perhaps seeing a peaceful dream
findings.explanation: Regular respiration and Shirou’s tentative image become an assertion that the sleepers enjoy the dream.

findings.highlight: Ryuudou Issei is sleeping peacefully as well
findings.evidenceJa: 生徒会室で時おり見せるような、のんびりとした寝顔のまま昏睡していた
findings.governingReading: Issei lies comatose with the relaxed sleeping face he sometimes shows in the student-council room
findings.explanation: mirror moon erases the specific familiar expression through which Shirou recognizes his friend inside the mass coma.

findings.highlight: The Master responsible for this disaster
findings.evidenceJa: 惨状の[ruby text=マスター char=2]原因
findings.governingReading: the cause of the devastation, read simultaneously as “Master”
findings.explanation: The English gives the conclusion but loses the cause/Master ruby mechanism that stages Shirou’s inference.

findings.highlight: We step into the shrine
findings.evidenceJa: お堂に踏み入る
findings.governingReading: they enter the Buddhist hall
findings.explanation: mirror moon calls a Buddhist temple hall a Shinto shrine.

findings.highlight: His chest must be pierced
findings.evidenceJa: 胸を貫かれたのか
findings.governingReading: perhaps his chest was pierced
findings.explanation: A visual hypothesis about the fatal wound becomes certainty.

findings.highlight: the man has lost enough blood to die
findings.evidenceJa: 出血はとうに生命限界を超えている
findings.governingReading: the bleeding has long since exceeded the limit compatible with life
findings.explanation: The English removes both the elapsed time and the degree beyond the fatal threshold.

findings.highlight: I know this man
findings.evidenceJa: 見覚えのある人物
findings.governingReading: a person Shirou recognizes or remembers seeing
findings.explanation: Visual familiarity becomes personal acquaintance.

findings.highlight: it seems he was Master to the one standing beside his body
findings.evidenceJa: 傍らに立ち尽くすモノの[ruby text=マスター]主であったモノらしい
findings.governingReading: he seems to have been the master of the thing standing frozen beside him
findings.explanation: The English humanizes Caster as “the one,” adds “his body,” and loses the repeated thing-language marking Shirou’s estrangement.

findings.highlight: looking down at her Master
findings.evidenceJa: [ruby text=マスター char=2]死体を見下ろしている
findings.governingReading: looking down at the corpse, read as “Master”
findings.explanation: The narration’s corpse/Master ruby and uncertain relationship become an unqualified possessive fact.

findings.highlight: mysterious dagger
findings.evidenceJa: 奇怪な短刀
findings.governingReading: bizarre or grotesque short dagger
findings.explanation: The English replaces visibly uncanny form with mere unknownness.

findings.highlight: Pain lances through my head, accompanied by a sense of apprehension
findings.evidenceJa: 頭痛と、警告めいた胸騒ぎ
findings.governingReading: a headache and an ominous stirring in his chest like a warning
findings.explanation: mirror moon intensifies the headache but reduces the distinct bodily warning to generic apprehension.

findings.highlight: I can tell that the dagger has dreadful power
findings.evidenceJa: よくない力が備わっているような
findings.governingReading: it seems the dagger possesses a malign power
findings.explanation: A trailing, uncertain perception becomes confident knowledge.

findings.highlight: does not answer
findings.evidenceJa: ぴくりとも反応しない
findings.governingReading: does not react or move even a twitch
findings.explanation: Physical motionlessness becomes a failure to reply, despite no question being asked.

findings.highlight: she tries to charge
findings.evidenceJa: 微かに身を落とし、一息でキャスターへと踏み込もうと
findings.governingReading: Saber lowers her body slightly and prepares to step into Caster’s range in a single breath
findings.explanation: The English discards stance, distance, and explosive timing from Saber’s attack preparation.

findings.highlight: don’t go near that dagger…! That thing can break contracts
findings.evidenceJa: あの短刀には触れるな……！　アレは魔術破りだ
findings.governingReading: do not touch the dagger; it breaks magecraft
findings.explanation: mirror moon changes the weapon’s established general function into contract breaking, then redundantly presents contract severance as only a possibility.

findings.highlight: unearthly power
findings.evidenceJa: 桁違いの解呪能力
findings.governingReading: dispelling power on an entirely different scale
findings.explanation: The English removes both the technical function and comparative magnitude of Rule Breaker.

findings.highlight: With her vigor gone
findings.evidenceJa: 生気のない姿
findings.governingReading: her lifeless appearance
findings.explanation: A visible corpse-like quality becomes the loss of prior energy or enthusiasm.

findings.highlight: I don’t know whose plot this is, but he is quite thorough
findings.evidenceJa: 誰の筋書きだか知らないけど
findings.governingReading: she does not know whose script or plot it is
findings.explanation: The English invents a male plotter.

findings.highlight: I do not want anything from a person who betrayed her master
findings.evidenceJa: 主を裏切った者の言葉など聞きたくもない
findings.governingReading: Saber does not even want to hear the words of one who betrayed her master
findings.explanation: A refusal to listen becomes a broader but less exact rejection of anything from Caster.

findings.highlight: take your punishment
findings.evidenceJa: ここで裁かれるがいい
findings.governingReading: be judged here
findings.explanation: Saber’s knightly language of judgment is reduced to receiving punishment.

findings.highlight: She starts laughing as if coughing up blood. maniacally.
findings.evidenceJa: 血を吐くように笑う
findings.governingReading: she laughs as though spitting blood
findings.explanation: mirror moon changes vomiting or spitting blood into coughing, then leaks a detached “maniacally” into a malformed sentence.

findings.highlight: points at Saber
findings.evidenceJa: その片腕をセイバーへ突き出す
findings.governingReading: thrusts one arm out toward Saber
findings.explanation: A whole-arm spellcasting gesture becomes pointing, suggesting a finger gesture absent from the source.

findings.highlight: She raises her sword without hesitation
findings.evidenceJa: キャスターを見据えたまま、躊躇うことなくその剣を振りかぶった
findings.governingReading: without taking her fixed gaze from Caster, Saber raises her sword without hesitation
findings.explanation: The English omits Saber maintaining visual control of her opponent.

findings.highlight: Caster disappears
findings.evidenceJa: キャスターが消滅していく
findings.governingReading: Caster is in the process of vanishing
findings.explanation: An ongoing Servant dissolution is compressed into a completed event.

findings.highlight: Caster’s magic was supreme
findings.evidenceJa: キャスターの魔術は卓絶したものだった
findings.governingReading: Caster’s magecraft was outstanding or extraordinary
findings.explanation: The English upgrades an exceptional comparative assessment into absolute supremacy and uses the wrong technical term.

findings.highlight: killed her in one blow
findings.evidenceJa: 一撃でキャスターを下した
findings.governingReading: defeated or brought Caster down with one blow
findings.explanation: mirror moon changes tactical defeat into killing, even though the preceding line separately depicts her disappearance.

findings.highlight: contact the hospital… no, Kotomine first
findings.evidenceJa: 言峰に連絡して後を任そう
findings.governingReading: contact Kotomine before the hospital and leave the aftermath to him
findings.explanation: The English retains the self-correction but omits assigning the remaining response and concealment to Kotomine.

findings.highlight: Nobody will know what happened to him, and he will disappear from everyone’s memory
findings.evidenceJa: 今夜を限りに消息を絶ち、生死不明のまま、いつか人々の記憶から消えていく
findings.governingReading: from this night he will vanish from contact, remain of unknown life or death, and someday fade from people’s memory
findings.explanation: mirror moon collapses disappearance, unresolved status, and eventual forgetting into a generic lack of knowledge.

findings.highlight: We have no time to waste
findings.evidenceJa: 立ち止まっている余裕はない
findings.governingReading: they have no leisure to stop moving
findings.explanation: The English moralizes pausing for the dead as wasted time.

findings.highlight: Saber turns and starts to walk
findings.evidenceJa: セイバーはお堂に背を向ける
findings.governingReading: Saber turns her back on the hall
findings.explanation: The English adds departure movement before Shirou’s final act of remembrance.

findings.highlight: Engraving the sight of the corpse into my mind
findings.evidenceJa: 亡骸を記憶に留めて
findings.governingReading: at least retaining the fallen body in memory
findings.explanation: The English intensifies quiet remembrance into deliberate mental engraving and shifts the object to the sight rather than the dead man.

findings.highlight: We have already determined that there is nobody here
findings.evidenceJa: 人がいない事は確認した筈です
findings.governingReading: they should already have confirmed that no person is nearby
findings.explanation: A bounded prior check is made into an authoritative determination.

findings.highlight: now that Caster is dead
findings.evidenceJa: キャスターが倒れた今
findings.governingReading: now that Caster has been defeated
findings.explanation: mirror moon again changes defeat into confirmed death.

findings.highlight: it should put an end to the mysterious coma incidents
findings.evidenceJa: 昏睡事件はなくなったんだ
findings.governingReading: the coma incidents have ended
findings.explanation: Shirou’s consoling conclusion is weakened into a prediction.

findings.highlight: That should be good enough for tonight
findings.evidenceJa: 今はそれだけで良しとする
findings.governingReading: for now, he should accept that alone as good
findings.explanation: The English changes an emotional present limit into a restriction to that night.

findings.highlight: Let’s get out of here and contact Kotomine
findings.evidenceJa: すぐに山を降りて言峰に連絡
findings.governingReading: immediately descend the mountain and contact Kotomine
findings.explanation: The exact exit route and urgency are reduced to leaving the current place.

findings.highlight: even though it’s really hard for me to leave this place
findings.evidenceJa: 後ろ髪を引かれる感覚を振り払って
findings.governingReading: shaking off the feeling of being pulled back by the hair
findings.explanation: mirror moon explains the reluctance but removes its bodily idiom and Shirou’s active effort to reject it.

findings.highlight: The man who used to be a Master lies silently in this holy place
findings.evidenceJa: 静まり返ったお堂には、マスターだった男の亡骸だけが残っていた
findings.governingReading: only the corpse of the man who had been a Master remains in the silent hall
findings.explanation: The English calls the location a “holy place,” moves silence onto the corpse, and omits that the body alone remains.
